entities.name: Sahachiro Hata
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sahachirō Hata  was a prominent Japanese bacteriologist who researched the bubonic plague under Kitasato Shibasaburō and assisted in developing the antisyphilitic drug arsphenamine in 1909 in the laboratory of Paul Ehrlich.
